Coiffures, tatouages, tenues et accessoi: Hairstyles, tattoos, outfits and accessories: everything that changes how Jason and Lucia look, in three expandable lists, with the announced collections and the shops Rockstar has shown.
Aucun prix GTA VI n’est publié : chaque: No GTA VI prices have been published: each row shows its status, and GTA V and GTA Online prices stay in their benchmark column. The collections described aren’t a list of items you can buy.
Quatre temps, chacun avec son statut : l: Four stages, each with its status: the screenshots, the editions, the Extended Look, then Rob Nelson’s interviews. No prices, no item lists.
Captures officielles : ce que Jason et L: Official screenshots: what Jason and Lucia wear
Débardeur imprimé « Leonida », chaîne, m: “Leonida” print tank top, chain, watch and cap for Jason; high bun, hoop earrings and sunglasses for Lucia. The images show items, not a store or a price.
Éditions : trois adresses et deux collec: Editions: three shops and two collections
L’Édition Ultimate ouvre Stock 305 (stre: The Ultimate Edition opens Stock 305 (streetwear by Stockyard), Sara’s Unisex Salon (signature hairstyles, Jason’s beard, Lucia’s makeup and nails) and Electric Fang Tattoo (over 50 tattoos designed by FAILE), and adds the Vice City Style and Goodtime Gear collections. The Vintage Vice City Pack gives Jason a pastel linen suit and a retro hairstyle, and Lucia a red sequin mini dress and curls. Rockstar also lists the basic options: hairstyle, facial hair, makeup, nails, and arm, leg and back tattoos.
Lucia choisit une tenue avant une soirée: Lucia picks an outfit before a night out while Jason comments; the duo robs gas stations with bandanas over their faces. Nothing is named or priced.
Rob Nelson : des milliers de tenues, des: Rob Nelson: thousands of outfits, salons everywhere
À Famitsu (traduit le 9 septembre) puis: Speaking to Famitsu (translated on September 9), then to GamingBible (September 10): “We have thousands of outfits”, earned in missions or bought, “countless clothing stores and hair salons”; you can cut your hair at the safehouse, with limited choices. To Dazed (September 6), stylist Jillian Carr: Vice City “is built around vanity”.
